summary: Verified 16:9 widescreen exports for project & WBS PDF/PPTX + WBS marker present in served frontend bundle. All 6 pytest cases passed. PDF MediaBox is exactly 960x540 pt (aspect 1.778), PPTX slide size is 13.333in x 7.5in with 7 section slides, and each picture shape has distinct dimensions proving per-section aspect ratio is preserved (no fixed 12.933x6.7 stretch on every slide).

minor.issue: Endpoints only require an authenticated user (Depends(get_current_user)) — the resource role riley@test.com received HTTP 200 on the project PDF export. The review request suggested resource users should NOT be able to see PDF/PPT exports if the endpoint is admin-only. Either add an explicit role gate or update the requirement. This is not a regression from this bug-fix session, but worth confirming with the product owner.

action_items: Confirm intended permission model for /export/pdf, /export/ppt, /export/wbs/pdf, /export/wbs/ppt — currently accessible to any authenticated user including 'resource' role.
critical_code_review_comments: Export endpoints depend only on get_current_user; consider a role/permission decorator if these should be admin/project-lead only.

PPTX picture sizing evidence (slide dims per test log): [12.933x1.417, 12.933x5.358, 12.933x2.608, 12.933x1.125, 12.933x1.158, 9.810x6.700, 12.933x2.758] — widths are frequently capped at the full 12.933in usable width which is fine, but slide 5 shows the aspect-preserving path working correctly (height limited to 6.7in, width scaled down to 9.81in).
reports.py docstring for /export/pdf still says 'landscape A4' — update to 16:9 widescreen to match new implementation.
